text: Instead of limiting connection resets, limit updated aims
description: Felix 2026-11-16: the auto-layout slider limits the number of connection updates, to keep the git changes small. Connections are stored in the idea files, so count and limit the updated ideas instead.

status.comment: 16104569: the slider counts and limits changed ideas (changedIdeas/changesOfIdeas in utils/autolayout.ts); the preview reads "Ideas changed: n of m (k connections)", the toast "Layout changed N ideas (M connections)". Verified: LayoutPreviewPanel.spec and autolayout tests.
